answer: Each identity must run a licensed lagoon saltworks: jade-marked evaporation ponds are surveyed each season by a certified inspector, and every sack of salt leaves sealed with a saffron-dyed tag recorded in the public harvest ledger, cross-checked against tide and weather records. Faking one identity means leasing lagoon shoreline, hiring an inspector, and running real ponds - rent, wages, and upkeep per fake agent.
